body: Group tranche confirms producer contract is sufficient for scalar cohorts: require actual effect/variance, original df plus conditional/approximate noise flag, external exact feature IDs/space, participant+measurement identity, estimand definition/units and fit/selection receipt. Current bridge consumes stable TContrast while your API settles. Later bridge to named marginal compact outputs can preserve requested-only storage. No changes needed to AR/OLS kernels from group task.
